log: Thou takest up a crude blade.
Thou takest up a leather jack.
You emerge into the waking forest.
Something stirs in the bone. A word surfaces — [kkiivsh]: the husk.
You take a cutting of the fleshy orange cap exudes a pungent aroma.
You move into the waking forest.
The world reassembles itself around you.
